tools.name: split_rent
tools.description: Split rent across rooms. Use when rent is fixed and needs dividing. Do NOT use when dividing variable costs like utilities; use split_utilities instead.

tools.name: split_utilities
tools.description: Split utility bills among housemates. Use when bills are shared, not when splitting rent (use split_rent).

tools.name: settle_up
tools.description: Calculate balances and minimal payments to settle shared household costs. Use when you need to resolve debts among housemates. Do NOT use when you need to create a roommate agreement; use roommate_agreement instead.

tools.name: roommate_agreement
tools.description: Generate a shared-living agreement for tenants. Use when you need a comprehensive agreement. Do NOT use when you only need to split utilities.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "split_rent" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Split monthly rent across rooms - equally or by room size - showing each room's share and, for shared rooms, each occupant's share." → after: "Split rent across rooms. Use when rent is fixed and needs dividing. Do NOT use when dividing variable costs like utilities; use split_utilities instead."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
